subject.why: The apron is instantly recognisable, complete with straps, frilly trim, polka dots, and the requested heart-shaped pocket.

category.why: The apron floats in three-quarter view with no ground surface against an orange gradient background with radiating sunburst rays.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermark, card frame, or characters present.

framing.why: The apron is well-centered with comfortable margins on all sides and no parts cut off.

colour.why: The palette is bright, warm, and saturated, with the red and white apron clearly readable against the orange background.

detail.why: The polka dots and frills are chunky and stylized with no micro-textures, noise, or unnecessary extra props.

style.why: The illustration matches the reference style with soft satin highlights, smooth 3D volumes, and no outlines.
